env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./l/app
stdout '^view ab c 2 9$'
stdout '^option 4 7$'
stdout '^absent -1 -1$'
stdout '^generic 5 x 3$'
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gouse$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/gouse$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
cd ..

env GOWORK=off
cd w/l
logos eject -o bout
exists bout/lib/lib.go
exists bout/app/app.go
mkdir bout/gouse
cp ../g/gouse/gouse.go bout/gouse/gouse.go
mkdir bout/gocmd
cp ../../extra/main.go bout/gocmd/main.go
cd bout
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./app
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./gocmd
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l lib app
! stdout .
cd ../../..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- extra/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/gouse"
	"example.com/l/lib"
)

func main() {
	s := lib.New()
	tags := gouse.Tags(s)
	fmt.Printf("view %s %s %d %d\n", tags[0], tags[1], len(tags), gouse.Idx(s)["k"])
	h := lib.NewHolder()
	var e lib.Shown = lib.Holder{}
	fmt.Printf("option %d %d\n", gouse.OptN(h), gouse.Num(h))
	fmt.Printf("absent %d %d\n", gouse.OptN(e), gouse.Num(e))
	sl := &lib.Slot[int]{}
	gouse.Set(sl, 3)
	fmt.Printf("generic %d %s %d\n", gouse.Int(lib.Cell[int]{V: 5}), gouse.Str(&lib.Cell[string]{V: "x"}), sl.Item)
}

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Tagged interface {
	const Tags const []string
}

type Index interface {
	const Idx const map[string]int
}

type Shelf struct : Tagged, Index {
	Tags const []string
	Idx  const map[string]int
}

func New() *Shelf {
	return &Shelf{Tags: []string{"ab", "c"}, Idx: map[string]int{"k": 9}}
}

type Item struct {
	N int
}

type Shown interface {
	const Opt *Item?
	const Num int?
}

type Holder struct : Shown {
	Opt *Item?
	Num int?
}

func NewHolder() *Holder {
	return &Holder{Opt: &Item{N: 4}, Num: 7}
}

type Valued[T any] interface {
	const V T
}

type Slotted[T any] interface {
	Item T
}

type Cell[T any] struct : Valued[T] {
	V T
}

type Slot[T any] struct : Slotted[T] {
	Item T
}

-- w/l/app/app.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/lib"
)

func main() {
	s := lib.New()
	var t lib.Tagged = s
	var i lib.Index = s
	fmt.Printf("view %s %s %d %d\n", t.Tags[0], t.Tags[1], len(t.Tags), i.Idx["k"] ?? 0)
	h := lib.NewHolder()
	var o lib.Shown = h
	var e lib.Shown = lib.Holder{}
	fmt.Printf("option %d %d\n", nOf(o.Opt), o.Num ?? -1)
	fmt.Printf("absent %d %d\n", nOf(e.Opt), e.Num ?? -1)
	var gi lib.Valued[int] = lib.Cell[int]{V: 5}
	var gs lib.Valued[string] = &lib.Cell[string]{V: "x"}
	sl := &lib.Slot[int]{}
	var w lib.Slotted[int] = sl
	w.Item = 3
	fmt.Printf("generic %d %s %d\n", gi.V, gs.V, sl.Item)
}

func nOf(p *lib.Item?) int {
	return p?.N ?? -1
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/gouse/gouse.go --
package gouse

import "example.com/l/lib"

func Tags(t lib.Tagged) []string { return t.Logos_GetTags() }

func Idx(i lib.Index) map[string]int { return i.Logos_GetIdx() }

func OptN(s lib.Shown) int {
	if p := s.Logos_GetOpt(); p != nil {
		return p.N
	}
	return -1
}

func Num(s lib.Shown) int {
	if n := s.Logos_GetNum(); n.Present {
		return n.Value
	}
	return -1
}

func Int(v lib.Valued[int]) int { return v.Logos_GetV() }

func Str(v lib.Valued[string]) string { return v.Logos_GetV() }

func Set(s lib.Slotted[int], v int) { s.Logos_SetItem(v) }

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/gouse"
	"example.com/l/lib"
)

func main() {
	s := lib.New()
	tags := gouse.Tags(s)
	fmt.Printf("view %s %s %d %d\n", tags[0], tags[1], len(tags), gouse.Idx(s)["k"])
	h := lib.NewHolder()
	var e lib.Shown = lib.Holder{}
	fmt.Printf("option %d %d\n", gouse.OptN(h), gouse.Num(h))
	fmt.Printf("absent %d %d\n", gouse.OptN(e), gouse.Num(e))
	sl := &lib.Slot[int]{}
	gouse.Set(sl, 3)
	fmt.Printf("generic %d %s %d\n", gouse.Int(lib.Cell[int]{V: 5}), gouse.Str(&lib.Cell[string]{V: "x"}), sl.Item)
}
